G2_stage_attribution.interpretation: stage gains are fully explained by closure edges added in the stage difference (relative tolerance); chain edges behave as subtrees.  Attributing edges by their creation time instead of their publication time moves late-published return-leg closures out of the action stage; the created means above are the time-true stage values
